stories.title: Sun Path: Create component file and basic SVG structure
stories.description: Create src/components/visualizations/SunPathDiagram.tsx with TypeScript, import SunPath type, create basic SVG canvas (500x500) with viewBox
stories.acceptance: Component renders empty SVG, imports compile, build passes

stories.title: Sun Path: Add polar coordinate system
stories.description: Draw concentric circles for altitude (0°, 30°, 60°, 90°) and radial lines for cardinal directions (N, E, S, W)
stories.acceptance: Circular diagram with grid, labeled cardinal directions

stories.title: Sun Path: Implement coordinate conversion
stories.description: Helper function polarToCartesian(azimuth, altitude) converts sun position to SVG x,y coordinates
stories.acceptance: Function correctly maps: azimuth 0°=top, 90°=right, altitude 0°=edge, 90°=center

stories.title: Sun Path: Draw sun path arc
stories.description: Plot sun's trajectory through the day as an SVG path using sunPath.positions data
stories.acceptance: Yellow/orange arc shows sun movement, updates with prop changes

stories.title: Sun Path: Mark sunrise, noon, sunset
stories.description: Add markers (circles or icons) at sunrise, solar noon, and sunset positions with labels
stories.acceptance: Three distinct markers visible on sun path with time labels

stories.title: Sun Path: Overlay horizon profile
stories.description: Draw filled area from center showing terrain horizon using HorizonProfile data
stories.acceptance: Gray/brown filled area represents terrain blocking, varies by azimuth

stories.title: Sun Path: Highlight visible vs shadowed
stories.description: Color-code sun path segments: bright where sun is visible, gray where blocked by terrain
stories.acceptance: Path changes color where it crosses horizon line

stories.title: Sun Path: Add current position indicator
stories.description: Animated dot or icon showing current sun position, moves with time slider prop
stories.acceptance: Indicator updates smoothly when currentTime prop changes

stories.title: Sun Path: Test and commit
stories.description: Test with sample data (Reykjavík summer/winter), verify responsive, build passes, git commit
stories.acceptance: Component works with real data, commit 'feat: T17 - sun path diagram'

stories.title: Horizon: Create component and SVG canvas
stories.description: Create src/components/visualizations/HorizonChart.tsx with SVG (width: 100%, height: 200px)
stories.acceptance: Component renders, imports HorizonProfile type, build passes

stories.title: Horizon: Add axes (azimuth 0-360, elevation 0-45)
stories.description: X-axis: azimuth 0-360° with N/E/S/W labels. Y-axis: elevation angle 0-45° with degree labels
stories.acceptance: Axes render correctly, cardinal directions marked on X-axis

stories.title: Horizon: Plot horizon profile line
stories.description: Draw line chart showing elevation angle across all azimuths using horizonProfile.profile data
stories.acceptance: Line follows terrain profile, smooth interpolation between points

stories.title: Horizon: Add fill gradient below horizon
stories.description: Fill area below horizon line with gradient (dark at bottom, lighter at top) representing terrain
stories.acceptance: Filled area makes horizon profile visually distinct

stories.title: Horizon: Add 0° reference line
stories.description: Dashed horizontal line at 0° elevation showing flat horizon reference
stories.acceptance: Dashed line visible, labeled 'Flat horizon'

stories.title: Horizon: Mark current sun position
stories.description: Sun icon or marker at current azimuth/altitude, moves with time slider prop
stories.acceptance: Sun marker updates position when sunPosition prop changes

stories.title: Horizon: Test and commit
stories.description: Test with Reykjavík data (Esja mountain ~15-20° to north), responsive width, build passes, commit
stories.acceptance: Chart shows realistic terrain, commit 'feat: T18 - horizon profile chart'

stories.title: Monthly: Create component and container
stories.description: Create src/components/visualizations/MonthlyChart.tsx, set up Recharts BarChart with responsive container
stories.acceptance: Component renders empty chart, Recharts imported, build passes

stories.title: Monthly: Configure chart axes and layout
stories.description: Y-axis: month names (Jan-Dec), X-axis: hours (0-800), horizontal bars layout
stories.acceptance: 12 month labels on Y-axis, hour scale on X-axis

stories.title: Monthly: Add sunlight hours bars
stories.description: Bar for each month showing totalHours from MonthlySunlight data, color: yellow/gold
stories.acceptance: 12 bars render, values match input data, June > December

stories.title: Monthly: Add theoretical hours overlay
stories.description: Stacked or overlaid bars showing theoreticalHours (lighter color) vs actualHours
stories.acceptance: Visual distinction between theoretical (light) and actual (bright) sunlight

stories.title: Monthly: Highlight terrain reduction
stories.description: Show lost hours (theoreticalHours - totalHours) as gray segment or annotation
stories.acceptance: Terrain shadow loss visible for each month

stories.title: Monthly: Add tooltip with details
stories.description: Hover tooltip shows: month name, totalHours, theoreticalHours, reductionPercent
stories.acceptance: Tooltip appears on hover, shows all metrics with proper formatting

stories.title: Monthly: Add annual total summary
stories.description: Text below chart: 'Annual Total: X,XXX hours (Y% terrain reduction)'
stories.acceptance: Summary calculates total from all months, formats numbers correctly

stories.title: Monthly: Responsive and test
stories.description: Make responsive (scales to container width), test with Reykjavík data, build passes, commit
stories.acceptance: Works on mobile/desktop, commit 'feat: T19 - monthly sunlight chart'
